seq_cyclic_consecutiveb.note: seq_cyclic_consecutiveb c u v holds when u and v are adjacent in the cyclic order of the raw sequence c, in either order: (u, v) or (v, u) occurs in zip c (rot 1 c), i.e. among the adjacent pairs and the closing pair (last, first). No path, edge, uniqueness, size or distinctness premise: [::] relates nothing, [:: a] relates a to itself, [:: a; b] relates exactly a and b, the closing pair of a longer sequence is adjacent, a repeated value may be self-adjacent through the closing pair; symmetric and invariant under rot, rotr and rev; on a MathComp cycle cyclically consecutive entries are related.

seq_cyclic_consecutive.note: The Prop form of seq_cyclic_consecutiveb (the same two memberships joined by \/), reflected by seq_cyclic_consecutiveP; equal to the open-path relation seq_consecutive of the closed sequence a :: rcons p a on a :: p.
